description: Station identifier key mismatch: the skill’s parsing/mapping code assumes each station record has an "id" field (e.g., s["id"]) for building station_ids and labels. The bike-rebalance task/output schema uses "station_id" (and related station fields like initial_bikes, station_capacity), so this will cause KeyError or incorrect ID↔index mappings when applied to the task’s data.json.

Hard-coded input path: the skill reads the instance from an absolute path "/root/data.json". The task specification only states a "data.json" file (no absolute location), so this assumption can break in environments where the file is not located at /root/data.json.
